info.title: ENHANCE API
info.description: Enhance is an API to find a person or organization in the Knowledge Graph using partial data

tags.name: Combine
tags.description: Enhance both a person and the employer data

get.description: Enrich a person or organization record with partial data input

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Diffbot entity type

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: DiffbotId of entity to enhance. Parameter can be used with types `Person` and `Organization`

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the entity to enhance. Parameter can be used with types `Person` and `Organization`

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Origin or homepage URI of entity to enhance. Parameter can be used with types `Person` and `Organization`

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Phone of the entity to enhance. Parameter can be used with types `Person` and `Organization`

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email of the entity to enhance. Parameter can be used only with type `Person`

parameters.name: employer
parameters.description: Employer of the entity to enhance. Parameter can be used only with type `Person`

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title of the entity to enhance. Parameter can be used only with type `Person`

parameters.name: school
parameters.description: School of the entity to enhance. Parameter can be used only with type `Person`

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location of the entity to enhance. Parameter can be used with types `Person` and `Organization`

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of the entity to enhance. Parameter can be used with types `Person` and `Organization`

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IP address of the entity to enhance. Parameter can be used with types `Person` and `Organization`

parameters.name: customId
parameters.description: User defined ID for correlation

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Enhance similarity threshold

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: `refresh=true` indicates that Diffbot will attempt to recrawl all the origins of the identified entity and reconstruct the returned entity from this refreshed data.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: `search=true` indicates that Diffbot will attempt to search the web for origins for the search query and merge relevant results with whats found in the KG.

parameters.name: nonCanonicalFacts
parameters.description: `nonCanonicalFacts=true` returns non-canonical facts.

parameters.name: jsonmode
parameters.description: `jsonmode=extended` returns origin information for facts.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semi-colon separated path filter to filter response json. You can use a simple dot notation `skills.name` or a JsonPath expression such as such as `$.name;$.locations.country.name`. For more advanced options, see [JsonPath Filtering](https://docs.diffbot.com/reference/filtering-fields) for syntax.

parameters.name: filterExclude
parameters.description: Semi-colon separated path filter to filter and exclude data from response json. You can use a simple dot notation `skills.name` or a JsonPath expression such as such as `$.name;$.locations.country.name`. For more advanced options, see [JsonPath Filtering](https://docs.diffbot.com/docs/en/kg-filtering) for syntax.

parameters.description:
The spec defines the columns to export. This is applicable for csv, xls and xslx formats.

Export spec specifies how to export the entity JSON to a csv. A simple export spec looks like `name;summary`. To specify more complex export spec, including specifying how many of a list of `industries` to return, or the ideal `employment` record, see [Exporting Columnar Format](https://docs.diffbot.com/reference/exporting-csv) and [JsonPath Filtering](https://docs.diffbot.com/docs/en/filtering-fields).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semi-colon separated path filter to filter response json. For more advanced options, see [JsonPath Filtering](https://docs.diffbot.com/reference/filtering-fields) for syntax.

parameters.name: filterExclude
parameters.description: Semi-colon separated path filter to filter and exclude data from response json. You can use a simple dot notation `skills.name` or a JsonPath expression such as such as `$.name;$.locations.country.name`. For more advanced options, see [JsonPath Filtering](https://docs.diffbot.com/docs/en/kg-filtering) for syntax.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for bulkjob results to export. Results will continue to export in the background. To only trigger an export, use 0.
